preset.accent_from_cover_description: Colors follow the cover of the playing song
preset.mode_locked_dark: This preset has only a dark mode
preset.mode_locked_light: This preset has only a light mode

theme.description: Light, dark or follow the system
theme.disabled_for_glass: The glass look needs the dark theme

shortcuts.description: Keys for playback and the app
shortcuts.recording_hint: Press a combination, or Esc to cancel
shortcuts.modifier_required: Add Ctrl, Alt or Shift to the key

storage.description: What Nuvo keeps on this device
storage.cache_limit_desc: Old saved audio is removed when the cache grows past this size

youtube.signed_out_description: Sign in to play with your account and see your playlists

account_playback.title: Play through the account
account_playback.description: Songs play with your account's quality and no extra ads

prompt_sign_in.title: Offer to sign in
prompt_sign_in.description: Nuvo suggests signing in when a song needs it

sync_library.title: Show account playlists
sync_library.description: Your account's playlists appear in the library

lastfm.description: Send what you play to your Last.fm profile
lastfm.signed_out_description: Save your API key, then connect your account
lastfm.approve_hint: Approve Nuvo on the Last.fm page, then press Done

enabled.title: Scrobble plays
enabled.description: A song counts once it has played for half its length or 4 minutes

keys.title: API key and secret
keys.description: Last.fm gives them for free on its API page. Changing them disconnects the account.

lastfm.not_approved: Last.fm has no approval yet. Approve Nuvo on the page that opened, then press Done.
lastfm.refused: Last.fm didn't accept the key or secret. Check them and try again.
lastfm.unreachable: Couldn't reach Last.fm. Check the connection and try again.

discord.description: Show the song you play on your Discord profile

enabled.title: Show what I'm listening to in Discord
enabled.description: On by default. The Discord desktop app must be running, and only your Discord friends see it. For a song with no web cover, Nuvo asks Apple Music and Deezer for one by artist and title.

status.connected: Connected. Discord shows what you play.
status.no_client: Discord isn't running. Nuvo connects within half a minute of it starting.
status.error: Couldn't connect to Discord: {message}. Nuvo tries again in a moment.
status.unavailable: This build of Nuvo can't connect to Discord.

reduce_effects.title: Reduce effects
reduce_effects.description: No glow, blur or extra motion. Also on while your system asks for less motion.

frame_rate.title: Moving backgrounds
frame_rate.description: Frames per second for the karaoke background. Fewer use less power.
